deadline.value: The priority PhD deadline for the Computer Science and Information Science programs is December 15, 2026.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Files go to the Doctoral Committee for review; no supervisor agreement is stated before admission.
supervisor.quote: your file will be sent to be reviewed by the Doctoral Committee

funding.value: All PhD students are supported with an assistantship; part-time students cannot be considered for one.
funding.quote: All PhD students are fully supported with an assistantship

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's is the minimum; post-master's applicants are also considered.
entry_route.quote: Admission for graduate study at Drexel University requires a four-year bachelor's degree

also.quote: Applicants for post-master's status must show potential for further study

app_fee.value: The computer science page states an application fee of $65 U.S.
app_fee.quote: Please note, an application fee of $65 U.S. is required.

gre_general.value: The program page says GRE scores are not required; the doctoral page calls them optional but recommended.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not required.

also.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Scores (must be five years old or less) are optional but recommended.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL internet test minimum 90 (the page also lists 577 paper and 233 computer scores).

english_waiver.value: The waiver covers US degrees and degrees from English-primary nations, so an Indian English-medium degree does not waive the test.
english_waiver.quote: or if completed in a nation with English as its primary language

notes: Regular deadline Mar. 15 appears only in a split table cell. The CCI page also lists a PhD in Information Science (not a field in this Atlas). The CS program says one letter is required and two are preferred.
name: PhD in Computer Science
